schema: Person(id INT64 primary key, age INT64 nullable); KNOWS(Person -> Person). Existing isolated fixture only. No automatic provisioning.

cases.baseline: MATCH (p:Person {id: 1})-[:KNOWS]->(f) WHERE f.age > 30 RETURN f.id AS id
cases.candidate: MATCH (p:Person {id: 1})-[:KNOWS]->(f WHERE f.age > 30) RETURN f.id AS id
cases.requirements: Seed id=1 has high fanout; record degree and qualifying fraction.

cases.candidate: MATCH p = TRAIL (a:Person WHERE a.id = 1)-[:KNOWS]->{1,3}(b) RETURN p
cases.requirements: Use a small bounded graph with cycles and parallel edges; full path multiset must match.

cases.baseline: MATCH (p:Person {id: 1})-[:KNOWS]->(f1), (p)-[:KNOWS]->(f2) RETURN f1.id AS first_id, f2.id AS second_id
cases.candidate: MATCH (p:Person {id: 1})-[:KNOWS]->(f1) MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(f2) RETURN f1.id AS first_id, f2.id AS second_id
cases.requirements: Moderate seed degree only: required output is degree squared; preserve all combinations/duplicates.

cases.baseline: MATCH (p:Person) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(f:Person) WHERE f.age > 30 RETURN p.id AS id, f.id AS friend_id
cases.candidate: MATCH (p:Person) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(f:Person WHERE f.age > 30) RETURN p.id AS id, f.id AS friend_id
cases.requirements: Include no-friend nodes, nonqualifying friends, NULL ages and duplicate edges.

cases.baseline: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE EXISTS { MATCH (p)-[:KNOWS]->(f) } RETURN p.id AS id
cases.candidate: MATCH (p:Person)-[:KNOWS]->(f) RETURN DISTINCT p.id AS id
cases.requirements: Person.id must be unique/non-null; include zero/low/high fanout and no parallel loss of required person rows.

cases.baseline: MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.id AS id ORDER BY id OFFSET 10000 LIMIT 20
cases.candidate: MATCH (p:Person) ORDER BY p.id OFFSET 10000 LIMIT 20 RETURN p.id AS id
cases.requirements: Person.id unique/non-null; more than 10020 nodes; ordering/index settings fixed.
